analysis:
Only base_text for .github/workflows/release-swift.yml lines 592-1243 and head_text for lines 1-590 were supplied. No patch hunks and no head text for lines 591 onward, so I could not tell what changed. No regression can be claimed from these excerpts.

Head lines 1-590 show the signing pipeline:
- resolve-env checks out master and runs verify-source before any credential-consuming job (head 173-186).
- build-and-release downloads the unsigned artifact and verifies it by source SHA, version and SDK (head 379-399).
- It validates the provisioning profile for team, keychain group and aps-environment=production (head 445-507).
- It runs a pre-sign runtime-smoke (head 569-582).

Base lines 592-1243 show these controls:
- App Attest entitlements are merged and verified (base 601-604, 657-659).
- get-task-allow and aps-environment=production are checked (base 660-669).
- The post-notarize bundle is compared byte-for-byte with bin/ copies (base 753-755).
- The final signed layout, the full SHA-256 CodeDirectory hash and the SDK version are checked (base 862-880). These feed A-011, A-017, T-034 and T-054.
- Publication is split into stage-release and publish-release. Only publish-release gets RELEASE_KEY (A-005), with a serialized concurrency group and a digest-pinned artifact download (base 1051-1062, 1159-1187).

Note for integration: build-and-release in head declares no job-level permissions, so it inherits workflow-level contents: write (head 132-134, 275-291). I could not tell whether that is new. Integration should diff the full head against base for: the permissions block; the artifact-id/digest outputs (head 287-288); the stage-release and publish-release jobs, which have no head text; the validation-only path; and the scripts/provider-release-publication.py and prepare-app-attest-entitlements.py changes. No cross-file interaction could be verified.
